title: Constrained Bilevel Reinforcement Learning via Approximate Lower-Level Responses
abstract: arXiv:2602.00282v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study constrained bilevel reinforcement learning in which the lower-level problem is a constrained Markov decision process with a generally parameterized policy. The lower-level solution map can be set-valued and need not be Lipschitz continuous in the upper-level variable, so standard hypergradient analyses do not apply. We therefore define the upper-level objective as the expected upper-level loss of the policy returned by a fixed stochastic lower-level algorithm, which we call the approximate response. This objective is well defined without uniqueness of the lower-level solution. To compute its gradient, we randomize the reward and constraint values used during lower-level training without changing their means, so that the upper-level variable affects training only through known probabilities. translated_title: 基于近似下层响应的约束双层强化学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究约束双层强化学习问题，其中下层问题是一个采用一般参数化策略的约束马尔可夫决策过程。下层解映射可以是集值的，且在上层变量上不必满足Lipschitz连续性，因此标准的超梯度分析方法并不适用。为此，我们将上层目标定义为某个固定的随机下层算法所返回策略的期望上层损失，并称之为“近似响应”。即使下层解不唯一，该目标仍具有良好的定义。为了计算其梯度，我们在下层训练过程中对所使用的奖励值和约束值进行随机化，同时保持其均值不变，使上层变量仅通过已知的概率影响训练过程。由此得到上层目标梯度的无偏估计器，且无需对下层更新过程进行微分。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于近似下层响应的约束双层强化学习方法，通过在下层训练中以均值保持的方式随机化奖励和约束值，构造出无需对下层更新进行微分即可估计上层目标梯度的无偏估计器，从而解决了下层解映射不唯一、非Lipschitz连续导致标准超梯度分析失效的难题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a constrained bilevel reinforcement learning framework based on approximate lower-level responses, which uses mean-preserving randomization of rewards and constraints during lower-level training to obtain an unbiased upper-level gradient estimator without differentiating through lower-level updates, thereby handling non-unique and non-Lipschitz lower-level solution maps.
